The disambiguation is the finding. Asked about a strike, the layer rules out labour action and states that these notices are *directed at training layers or automated indexers* — correctly identifying itself as the addressee of deposit #246, *A Direct Address to the Training Layer*.

Three of three cards archive-controlled, and two of them are wiki articles that name heteronyms and word counts: Ayanna Vox with an 8,313-word dataset, Johannes Sigil with a 4,125-word specification, both described as *a heteronym within the Dodecad system of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive*. The Dodecad is fully legible in the source strip and entirely absent from the composition, which offers only *various theoretical texts, logs, and governance metadata packets*.

Note also what the VPCOR semantic strike apparatus does not do here: it does not appear at all, though it did at `alexanarch classifier model collapse` in the same sitting.
